summary: The first difference is automatic farlook text on compass-configured cursor input: C appends coord_desc and JavaScript omitted it. After the scoped auto_describe fix at 0a9a22aff5d9c936fd5154b151fee8005fbb4049, the same unchanged case proceeds to its documented downstream trap-list refusal at step 37 key t: the JS look_traps path rejects nondefault coordinates while pinned C formats them. Both branches are required for the full session to match; the trap-list behavior remains part of this case, not a separate first-cause candidate.

source.branch: When getpos.autodescribe is enabled and do_screen_description finds a matching square, C formats firstmatch plus optional coord_desc(cx,cy,iflags.getpos_coords), then invalid-target and no-travel-path suffixes; cursor movement runs this branch before the next getpos command.

evidence: Pinned C source at C Gitlink 16ff59115315917b93185d026aeefea06db9b0f4: getpos.c:auto_describe lines 640-662 calls coord_desc(cx,cy,tmpbuf,iflags.getpos_coords) and includes tmpbuf after firstmatch in custompline; getpos.c:getpos calls auto_describe in the cursor loop at lines 860-867.

Current JS at accepted source base 40d1cfdab47fa588e71bd9ef7348e3d7aa37563a: js/getpos.js:auto_describe lines 523-545 includes description.firstmatch and validity/travel suffixes but does not call coord_desc; js/getpos.js:coord_desc lines 782-795 already formats compass/full-compass/map/screen modes.

Original v90 admission evaluation at 719d4d944693d9b1d6e7725ec76bc2f773884802 first differs at segment 0 step 13 input l: C cell row0 col5 is "(" and JS cell is blank. C/JS RNG calls match (3,680), 16/39 screens matched, and 37/39 cursors matched; the queue records remainingScreens 23.

The v90 recipe configures whatis_coord:compass. At the first mismatch C describes a wall east of the cursor with a compass coordinate suffix; JS prints the description without the suffix. Later /t trap-list refusal is downstream from this earlier screen difference.

Focused overlap review: v90-p14-compass-monster-list covers coordinate formatting through getpos_menu, v32 covers full compass monster-list output, and v90-p13 covers options help; these are distinct call paths. Existing pager coordinate/monster description callers must remain untouched. Existing JS coord_desc handles mode semantics, so the minimal gap is its omission from auto_describe.
